items: [Notice Before Purchase] The laptop you received is brand new and unused. To enhance user experience and considering some customers may find the initial setup unfamiliar, we pre-configured the startup guide. Start using it directly without tedious setup. Also, the operating system is the latest OS, we don't recommend you update it. Contact us for any questions or assistance. We're always here to help and ensure a smooth user experience.

[12th Gen Quad-Core Processor] This laptop has a 12th Gen Processor N95 that delivers powerful performance for everyday tasks. The evolutionary architecture automatically allocates Performance Cores to demanding single-thread tasks, while the Efficiency Cores concentrate on seriously multithreaded workloads. For the moments when you need the acceleration, push CPU speed up from 1.7GHz to a peak speed of 3.4GHz.

[8GB DDR4 RAM for Smooth Operation] This traditional laptop computer features 8GB DDR4 memory modules, resulting in effective memory. DDR4 technology delivers significantly faster data transfer and lower power consumption than DDR3, boosting responsiveness while extending battery life. Eliminate frustrating lag, slowdowns, and crashes.

[256GB M.2 SSD for Data Storage] This business laptop comes with a 256GB M.2 SSD for data storage, providing fast and reliable storage for all your files, documents, and media without compromising on speed. Enjoy seamless productivity and entertainment without storage anxiety. Organize your entire digital world effortlessly.

[Clear Full HD Display] With 15.6 inches 1080P, three-sided slim-bezel NanoEdge  display, this notebook laptop offers vibrant colors and wide viewing angles for an immersive multimedia experience. Stay connected with built-in WiFi5 and Bluetooth capabilities, while the HDMI port allows you to connect to external displays or projectors. The integrated webcam makes video conferencing and online meetings a breeze.

[Your Satisfaction Guaranteed] We stand by every laptop with a hassle-free warranty, 24/7 customer support. Committed to transparency and quality, we protect your purchase with secure packaging, detailed guides, and lifetime software update access. Your trust drives us!
